payload.body: You tend to agree with the plan, play easygoing, and then become distant when your real preference never enters the relationship. At other times, you protect your desire so firmly that another person's needs feel like interference. This often comes from learning that approval depended on being pleasant and undemanding. State one preference before deciding whether the connection can hold it.
payload.astroHint: Lilith opposite Venus can make being liked and being honest about what you like feel like competing needs.
